import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Identify roadside and general stations
station_types_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY station_type, id
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(station_types_query, engine)
print("Station types:")
print(stations_df)

roadside_station_ids = stations_df[stations_df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE']['id'].tolist()
general_station_ids = stations_df[stations_df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL']['id'].tolist()
print(f"\nRoadside station IDs: {roadside_station_ids}")
print(f"General station IDs: {general_station_ids}")

# Step 2: Query hourly data for October 2025 (2025-10-01 00:00 to 2025-11-01 00:00)
aq_query = text("""
SELECT station_id, datetime, no2, pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
""")
aq_df = pd.read_sql(aq_query, engine)
aq_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(aq_df['datetime'])
aq_df['hour'] = aq_df['datetime'].dt.hour
print(f"\nTotal hourly readings in October 2025: {len(aq_df)}")
print(f"Unique stations: {aq_df['station_id'].nunique()}")

# Step 3: Compute average NO2 and PM2.5 for roadside stations
roadside_data = aq_df[aq_df['station_id'].isin(roadside_station_ids)]
general_data = aq_df[aq_df['station_id'].isin(general_station_ids)]

print(f"\nRoadside readings: {len(roadside_data)}")
print(f"General readings: {len(general_data)}")

no2_roadside_avg = roadside_data['no2'].mean()
pm25_roadside_avg = roadside_data['pm2_5'].mean()
no2_general_avg = general_data['no2'].mean()
pm25_general_avg = general_data['pm2_5'].mean()

print(f"\nRoadside avg NO2: {no2_roadside_avg:.2f}")
print(f"General avg NO2: {no2_general_avg:.2f}")
print(f"Roadside avg PM2.5: {pm25_roadside_avg:.2f}")
print(f"General avg PM2.5: {pm25_general_avg:.2f}")

# Step 4: Calculate roadside-to-general ratios
no2_roadside_general_ratio = round(no2_roadside_avg / no2_general_avg, 2)
pm25_roadside_general_ratio = round(pm25_roadside_avg / pm25_general_avg, 2)

print(f"\nNO2 roadside-to-general ratio: {no2_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"PM2.5 roadside-to-general ratio: {pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")

# Determine which pollutant has larger roadside enhancement
more_traffic_dominated = "NO2" if no2_roadside_general_ratio > pm25_roadside_general_ratio else "PM2.5"
print(f"More traffic-dominated pollutant: {more_traffic_dominated}")

# Step 5: Compute rush-hour and off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratios for roadside stations
# Rush hours: 7-9 AM and 5-7 PM (17-19)
roadside_data['is_rush'] = roadside_data['hour'].isin([7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19])

rush_data = roadside_data[roadside_data['is_rush'] == True]
offpeak_data = roadside_data[roadside_data['is_rush'] == False]

print(f"\nRush hour roadside readings: {len(rush_data)}")
print(f"Off-peak roadside readings: {len(offpeak_data)}")

# Compute NO2/PM2.5 ratio for each hour, then average
rush_data['no2_pm25_ratio'] = rush_data['no2'] / rush_data['pm2_5']
offpeak_data['no2_pm25_ratio'] = offpeak_data['no2'] / offpeak_data['pm2_5']

rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(rush_data['no2_pm25_ratio'].mean(), 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(offpeak_data['no2_pm25_ratio'].mean(), 2)

print(f"Rush hour NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"Off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

# Store intermediate results

print(f"no2_roadside_avg: {no2_roadside_avg:.2f}")
print(f"pm25_roadside_avg: {pm25_roadside_avg:.2f}")
print(f"no2_general_avg: {no2_general_avg:.2f}")
print(f"pm25_general_avg: {pm25_general_avg:.2f}")
print(f"no2_roadside_general_ratio: {no2_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"pm25_roadside_general_ratio: {pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"more_traffic_dominated: {more_traffic_dominated}")
print(f"rush_no2_pm25_ratio: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Step 1: Identify roadside stations
roadside_stations_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
""")
roadside_stations = pd.read_sql(roadside_stations_query, engine)
print("Roadside stations:")
print(roadside_stations)
print(f"Number of roadside stations: {len(roadside_stations)}")

# Step 2: Query all hourly air quality data for roadside stations in October 2025
aq_query = text("""
SELECT station_id, datetime, no2, pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id IN (SELECT id FROM air_quality_station WHERE station_type = 'ROADSIDE')
AND datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
""")
aq_df = pd.read_sql(aq_query, engine)
aq_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(aq_df['datetime'])
aq_df['hour'] = aq_df['datetime'].dt.hour
print(f"\nTotal records for roadside stations in October 2025: {len(aq_df)}")

# Step 3: Filter for rush hours (08:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00)
rush_data = aq_df[
    ((aq_df['hour'] >= 8) & (aq_df['hour'] < 9)) |
    ((aq_df['hour'] >= 17) & (aq_df['hour'] < 19))
]
print(f"\nRush hour records: {len(rush_data)}")

# Step 4: Filter for off-peak hours (00:00-05:00, 10:00-15:00)
offpeak_data = aq_df[
    ((aq_df['hour'] >= 0) & (aq_df['hour'] < 5)) |
    ((aq_df['hour'] >= 10) & (aq_df['hour'] < 15))
]
print(f"Off-peak hour records: {len(offpeak_data)}")

# Step 5: Calculate NO2/PM2.5 ratio for each valid record (where pm2_5 > 0)
rush_data_valid = rush_data[rush_data['pm2_5'] > 0].copy()
rush_data_valid['ratio'] = rush_data_valid['no2'] / rush_data_valid['pm2_5']

offpeak_data_valid = offpeak_data[offpeak_data['pm2_5'] > 0].copy()
offpeak_data_valid['ratio'] = offpeak_data_valid['no2'] / offpeak_data_valid['pm2_5']

print(f"\nValid rush hour records (pm2_5 > 0): {len(rush_data_valid)}")
print(f"Valid off-peak records (pm2_5 > 0): {len(offpeak_data_valid)}")
